title: diplacus douglasii
intro: Diplacus douglasii, commonly known as Douglas' mint, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States. It is a member of the Lamiaceae family, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Douglas' mint include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea and vomiting, and act as an anti-inflammatory. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
